answer.rationale: Renegotiate the expiring incumbent contract using market benchmarks and a multi-year or volume-pricing option. This is the best available path toward the 18% spend reduction while preserving proven integration and delivery continuity. Switching suppliers or deferring with only 14 days remaining and no production buffer creates unacceptable delivery risk; however, the achievable savings and incumbent acceptance remain uncertain until the archived negotiation evidence is verified and terms are offered.
